capabilities: Fetch page metadata into frontmatter without an API key
Fill empty frontmatter fields from folder-defined profiles
Fill frontmatter fields using AI models
Write company funding data into notes as a json block
extras: Basic direct fetching works with no API key or rate limit; optional keys raise limits and unlock some commands. API keys are stored in Obsidian's keychain rather than plugin settings, and desktop-only, requires Obsidian 1.13+.
motivation: The author manages site-wide content in Obsidian, where each review note's frontmatter becomes a card on the site, and built Metafetch to fill in those cards.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a URL property into filled frontmatter, so link cards, Bases, and Dataview lack source details.

relations.evidence: Fetch via Microlink | Same fields, through the Microlink API.
For the OpenGraph.io commands, add your key under Settings → Metafetch → OpenGraph.io.
from: [direct, firecrawl] falls back to Firecrawl when a site refuses a plain fetch

summary: Metadata fetcher that pulls a URL's title, description, image, favicon, authors, and social links into note frontmatter.
